User Guide

The User Guide provides comprehensive, task-oriented documentation for using IFU Analyzer.

Whether you’re just starting out or looking for specific features, this section covers:

  • What the different panels and buttons do

  • How to load and explore your data

  • Common analysis workflows

  • Advanced visualization options

  • Exporting your results
